claims.text: The excerpt shows a series of failed SSH authentication attempts from the same remote host, c9063558.virtua.com.br, with two separate processes, 13318 and 13323, logging the failures.
Later, multiple FTP connections are established from a different IP address, 202.82.200.188, with four separate ftpd processes, 13511, 13512, 13513, and 13521, logging the connections.
These events indicate potential security issues, including a possible brute-force attack on the SSH service and multiple simultaneous FTP connections from a single IP address.
